roadmap.title: Story and missables (first playthrough)
roadmap.description: Play the story on any difficulty, clearing the eight missable achievements in their chapters, and pick up the early incidental achievements (training, money, telephone card, Shakedown) while the map opens.

roadmap.title: Real Estate Royale (Kiryu)
roadmap.description: Run the Kamurocho property business: buy all areas, dominate one area for the share milestone, buy Disco City Boy, spend toward the billion, finish the storyline and get a cigarette lit as the area king.

roadmap.title: Cabaret Club Czar (Majima)
roadmap.description: Run Club Sunshine in Sotenbori: build fans, max a platinum hostess, and defeat all five rival clubs to finish the storyline.

roadmap.title: Substories, friends and Amon
roadmap.description: Complete all 100 substories across both characters, including the telephone club dates and the two final Amon fights; finish in Premium Adventure if any remain.

roadmap.title: Minigames and collectibles
roadmap.description: Clear every minigame counter, win all Pocket Circuit races, all disco songs and the JCC tournaments, and pull a top-grade Dream Machine item.

roadmap.title: Battle challenges, equipment and Climax Battles
roadmap.description: Unlock every style ability, complete the Dragon & Tiger equipment collection and weapon searches, win the Endless Rout, and clear all 32 Climax Battles.

roadmap.title: Completion List 100%
roadmap.description: Finish the remaining Adventure, Battle, Business, Substories and Minigames counters until the Completion List reads 374/374.

roadmap.title: Legend playthrough
roadmap.description: Clear the story again from a fresh save on Legend difficulty, repeating the eight story missables along the way.

roadmap.title: Final wrap-up
roadmap.description: The completion reward unlocks automatically once the other 54 achievements are earned.

achievements.description: Obtain all other achievements.
achievements.summary: Earn the other 54 achievements to unlock the final completion reward.

guide.context: The reward tracks the other 54 entries and has no separate requirement, so it unlocks automatically as the last outstanding achievement is earned.

steps.text: Complete every other achievement on the list; the final reward unlocks as the last one is earned.

achievements.description: Complete the main story on Legend difficulty.
achievements.summary: Finish all 17 story chapters on @mechanic{Legend} difficulty using a second, fresh save.

guide.context: Legend cannot inherit progress from the first playthrough. When a fight ends in defeat, the game offers no retry, so reload the last manual save; enemies deal more damage, player damage is reduced and the eight story missables are active again. The guide author cleared the run in about eight hours while skipping cutscenes.

steps.text: Start a new game and select @mechanic{Legend} difficulty.
Buy power and health upgrades early, use @mechanic{Beast} for Kiryu and @mechanic{Breaker} for Majima, and keep @item{Staminan} healing items stocked.
Play all 17 chapters, saving at payphones before long battles and bosses; on defeat reload the last save instead of continuing.

Repeat the eight story missables in their chapters: @npc{Rich Taste}, @npc{Smooth Criminal}, @npc{Business Etiquette 101}, @npc{Best Served Cold?}, @npc{It Takes Two}, @npc{They Won't Mind}, @npc{Big Hair in the Crosshairs} and @npc{Hitting the Bottle}.
steps.note: The achievement pops on the results screen after the final chapter.

achievements.description: Get started with Real Estate Royale.
achievements.summary: Complete the @mechanic{Real Estate Royale} tutorial in Chapter 5 as Kiryu.

guide.context: Real Estate Royale opens in Chapter 5 after Kiryu meets the Leisure King; the office sits in the Sugita Building's alley at the north end of Tenkaichi Street. The tutorial advances the business to the point where Kiryu begins receiving regular property payouts.

steps.text: Play Chapter 5 (An Honest Living) until Yamanoi opens the office and gives Kiryu ¥15,000,000.
Leave the office and buy @loc{Sukiyaki Muranaka} on Tenkaichi Street for ¥14,000,000.
Return to the office and collect the first payout; the achievement pops when the tutorial completes.

achievements.description: Get 100% share in any area.
achievements.summary: Occupy 100% of one Real Estate Royale area; the Leisure King area is the fastest target.

guide.context: Area share rises as owned buildings are upgraded and payouts are collected, and each king battle triggers from that area's progress. Losing a king challenge takes back properties and share, so save before challenging one. Dominating an area also enables the street cigarette event used by @npc{Generosity of Strangers}.

steps.text: From Chapter 5-6 onward, work the @loc{Leisure King area}: buy its properties and assign managers, advisors and security staff.
Keep upgrading that area's buildings and collect payouts until its share counter reaches 100%.
Take over the area; the achievement pops when the occupation completes.

achievements.description: Purchase the most expensive property.
achievements.summary: Buy the @item{Disco City Boy} property for ¥1,228,800,000 in the Media King area.

guide.context: Disco City Boy is the most expensive property in the game and belongs to the Media King area, the last of the five areas to open. Property profits, chapter rewards and Mr. Shakedown farming (with the Deep Pockets shrine skill) fund the purchase.

steps.text: Progress Real Estate Royale until the @loc{Media King area} unlocks after the Gambling King is defeated.
Open the property list, find @item{Disco City Boy} at ¥1,228,800,000 and purchase it; the achievement pops on the purchase.

achievements.description: Get started with Cabaret Club Czar.
achievements.summary: Complete the @mechanic{Cabaret Club Czar} tutorial at Club Sunshine as Majima in Chapter 7.

guide.context: Club Sunshine opens during Chapter 7 (A Dark Escape) when Youda introduces Majima to the club. The tutorial teaches hand signals, seating and @mechanic{Sunshine Fever} before the first night resolves.

steps.text: Play Chapter 7 as Majima until the story introduces Club Sunshine.
Finish the tutorial night; the achievement pops after the following cutscene.

achievements.description: Get over 1,000 fans in any area.
achievements.summary: Get more than 1,000 fans in a single cabaret area at Club Sunshine.

guide.context: Fans accumulate per area from served customers and from bought partner shops. Each area's rival battle opens at a fan threshold (Mars 1,500; Jupiter 3,000; Mercury 4,000; Venus 5,000; Moon 10,000), so the starting Mars counter passes 1,000 during normal progression.

steps.text: Run cabaret services at @loc{Club Sunshine} and keep customers happy by answering hand-signal requests correctly.
Buy Mars-area partner shops when cash allows to speed up fan growth.
Watch the area fan counter; the achievement pops once it passes 1,000.

achievements.description: Max out the level of a platinum hostess.
achievements.summary: Raise one platinum hostess at Club Sunshine to her maximum of level 40.

guide.context: Platinum hostesses cap at level 40 while bronze, silver and gold hostesses cap at 30. A hostess gains experience from Special Training, which mixes customer-service dialogue with date minigames, and from working services; the guide author needed about 20-30 services while rotating staff so their HP recovered. Yuki is the first platinum, and each rival club defeated adds another hostess. If Kanehara wins the Club Venus battle he takes Yuki, but any other platinum can be trained instead.

steps.text: Defeat the rival clubs to unlock additional platinum hostesses, starting with Yuki at Club Sunshine.
Complete the platinum hostess's Special Training sessions, answering the dialogue prompts correctly and performing well in the date minigames.
Schedule the hostess on cabaret nights and rotate the rest of the staff so her HP stays healthy.
Keep training and working her until her level reaches 40; the achievement pops at the maximum level.

achievements.description: Get over 50% on your Completion List.
achievements.summary: Push the Completion List past 50% by clearing entries across Adventure, Battle, Business, Substories and Minigames.

guide.context: The list holds 374 entries: Adventure 79, Battle 84, Business 99, Substories 27 and Minigames 85. Story progress plus a moderate side-content pass crosses the line before the postgame; a recorded midpoint stood at Adventure 67, Battle 45, Business 11, Substories 19 and Minigames 45.

steps.text: Track totals in the Completion List menu under the five section headings.
Clear counters in any order: telephone cards, Dream Machine visits, substories, training, heat actions, businesses and minigames.
Continue until the overall total passes 50%; the achievement pops at 188 entries.

achievements.description: Get 100% on your Completion List.
achievements.summary: Complete all 374 entries on the Completion List for a true 100% file.

guide.context: The five sections and their sizes: Adventure 79, Battle 84, Business 99, Substories 27 and Minigames 85. Inventory screens double as trackers, showing components for Kiryu and equipment parts for Majima. Several counters are RNG-limited through Dragon & Tiger dispatch, including the 100 weapons, 70 gear items and 96 equipment parts.

steps.text: Clear the Adventure section: all 90 telephone cards, 50 Dream Machine purchases, 30 video clips, restaurant menus and the travel and money counters.
Clear the Battle section: 100 weapons, 70 gear items, 96 equipment parts, heat actions, 200 defeats per fighting style, Mr. Shakedown wins, training masters and coliseum wins.
Clear the Business section: 50 properties, 50 partnerships, 50 S-rank shops, hostess accessories and both business storylines.
Clear the Substories section: all 100 substories, 20 friend friendships and the two Amon fights.
Clear the Minigames section: every karaoke and disco score, Pocket Circuit part and race, arcade target, casino target and mahjong requirement until the list reads 374/374.

achievements.description: Complete 10 substories.
achievements.summary: Complete 10 of the 100 substories in Kamurocho or Sotenbori.

guide.context: Substories are chapter-gated but remain available in Premium Adventure, so none can be permanently lost. Wrong dialogue choices change item rewards rather than completion, and each completed substory also feeds the Completion List's Substories section.

steps.text: Watch the map for the blue ! markers that start substories and accept the nearby character's request.
Finish 10 substories of any kind; the achievement pops on the tenth completion.

achievements.description: Complete 40 substories.
achievements.summary: Complete 40 substories across Kiryu's and Majima's campaigns.

guide.context: Kiryu has 60 substories in Kamurocho and Majima has 40 in Sotenbori, and their completions count toward the same 40 total. Substories unlock as chapters open and stay available in Premium Adventure.

steps.text: Clear substories whenever the map shows a ! marker during story chapters.
Finish any 40 in total across both characters; the achievement pops on the fortieth.

achievements.description: Complete all substories.
achievements.summary: Complete all 100 substories in Kamurocho and Sotenbori, including the two Amon fights.

guide.context: Nothing is permanently missable because unfinished substories stay available in Premium Adventure. The final two, So Amon for Kiryu and Jo Amon for Majima, only appear after every other substory for that character is done. Wrong dialogue choices change item rewards rather than completion. Chapter numbers show when each substory becomes available.

achievements.description: Spend one billion yen.
achievements.summary: Spend a cumulative ¥1,000,000,000 on any purchases across the save file.

guide.context: Every purchase counts, including properties, upgrades, weapons, gear and shop items. Real Estate Royale property buys are the fastest single sink, and spending by both characters accumulates toward the total.

steps.text: Keep buying properties, upgrades and expensive gear as the two businesses generate money.
Continue until lifetime spending passes ¥1,000,000,000; the achievement pops at that mark.

achievements.description: Throw away money on the street.
achievements.summary: Throw ¥100,000 onto the street with the Cash Confetti ability.

guide.context: Cash Confetti is taught to Kiryu in Chapter 6 during the scene where he leaves the Empty Lot; Majima learns the equivalent throw in Chapter 8 from Mr. Moneybags. Throwing by either character satisfies the achievement, and the thrown money is lost.

steps.text: Reach Chapter 6 as Kiryu (or Chapter 8 as Majima) and trigger the scene that teaches the money-throw ability.
Face an open street and throw ¥100,000 once; the achievement pops on the first throw.

achievements.description: Throw away a total of five million yen.
achievements.summary: Throw away a cumulative ¥5,000,000 with the money-throw ability (50 throws of ¥100,000).

guide.context: Progress accumulates across both characters, so partial throws from Kiryu and Majima combine. The throw ability is available from Chapter 6 as Kiryu and Chapter 8 as Majima.

steps.text: Use the money-throw input on open streets and scatter ¥100,000 per throw.
Repeat until 50 throws have been scattered; the achievement pops on the throw that passes ¥5,000,000.

achievements.description: Pick up a telephone card.
achievements.summary: Pick up any telephone card flashing on the ground in Kamurocho or Sotenbori.

guide.context: Cards are white flashing pickups, 45 per city. Each girl's set has Type A, B and C cards, and only the next letter appears after the previous card in the set is collected. The Card Watcher accessory bought at the CP Shrine shows the cards on the map. An easy early Kamurocho card is Miho Tono Type A, under the bench in Public Park 3 near the Tenkaichi Alley save point.

steps.text: During free exploration, look for the flashing white objects along streets, alleys and interiors.
Walk over any one telephone card; the achievement pops on the first pickup.

achievements.description: Watch a sexy video.
achievements.summary: Watch a full erotic video at a Gandhara parlor after earning a video clip.

guide.context: Gandhara Kamurocho sits on Senryo Avenue and only plays clips that have been collected. The fastest clip comes from maxing Officer Kikuchi's friendship in Chapter 2 at Senryo Avenue North, which awards Nanase Otoha's video; the Sushi Gin Chef, Emiri and Luka friendships also award clips. Thirty clips exist in total and are tracked by the Completion List.

steps.text: In Chapter 2, let @npc{Officer Kikuchi} search the inventory at Senryo Avenue North until his friendship gauge fills and he gives you @item{Nanase Otoha's video}.
Enter @loc{Gandhara} on Senryo Avenue, select the video and watch it to the end; the achievement pops when the clip finishes.

achievements.description: Get a top-grade item from a Dream Machine.
achievements.summary: Pull a top-grade item from a ¥1,000,000 Dream Machine.

guide.context: Dream Machines are the street vending machines, and their item rarity follows the price tier of the pull; a machine's tier changes when its stock refreshes, so a cheap machine can become a ¥1,000,000 machine later. Top-grade results include the Golden Rifle. West Park in Kamurocho is the only spot with two machines side by side, which doubles attempts per reload.

steps.text: Bring at least ¥1,000,000 and save at the @loc{West Park} payphone in Kamurocho.
Check the two West Park machines; if neither offers a ¥1,000,000 pull, wait for the stock to refresh.
Pull the ¥1,000,000 machine and reload the save if the item is not top-grade; repeat until a top-grade item appears, and the achievement pops.

achievements.description: Complete one training mission with each master.
achievements.summary: Complete one training mission with each of the six masters: Bacchus, Kamoji, Miss Tatsu, Komeki, Fei Hu and Areshi.

guide.context: Each master's introduction is a substory. Kiryu's masters are Bacchus in Tenkaichi Alley, Kamoji at the Shichifuku Parking Lot and Miss Tatsu at Tokyo Pier; Majima's are Komeki at Ashitaba Park, Fei Hu at Dragon & Tiger Sotenbori and Areshi in the Shofukucho West U-shaped alley. One completed mission per master is enough here; finishing their full courses is only needed for Master of Style.

steps.text: As Kiryu, finish the introduction substories for @npc{Bacchus}, @npc{Kamoji} and @npc{Miss Tatsu}, then complete one training bout with each.
As Majima, finish the introduction substories for @npc{Komeki}, @npc{Fei Hu} and @npc{Areshi}, then complete one training bout with each; the achievement pops with the sixth master.

achievements.description: Purchase ten or more abilities.
achievements.summary: Purchase 10 or more abilities from the upgrade menus.

guide.context: Any ability node counts, in any fighting style and for either character. The ten cheapest early nodes are affordable long before the businesses generate serious money, and every purchase also feeds the Completion List's style counters.

steps.text: Open the pause menu's upgrade tree and buy ten abilities, mixing characters or styles if needed; the achievement pops on the tenth purchase.

achievements.description: Obtain all abilities for every style.
achievements.summary: Unlock every ability for Brawler, Rush, Beast, Thug, Breaker and Slugger.

guide.context: The two Legend styles, Dragon of Dojima and Mad Dog of Shimano, do not count. Recorded purchase costs for the six styles total: Brawler ¥15,722,830,000; Rush ¥18,221,200,000; Beast ¥19,659,200,000; Thug ¥9,662,200,000; Breaker ¥8,873,200,000; Slugger ¥9,356,800,000. Some nodes stay locked until the matching style's training master is finished or the relevant business storyline completes.

steps.text: Finish all six training master courses so every ability node becomes available.
Complete both business storylines for their unlock rewards.
Farm money through Mr. Shakedown with the Deep Pockets shrine skill and through business payouts.
Buy out all six ability trees; the achievement pops when the last node of the six main styles is purchased.

achievements.description: Get five or more play bonuses fighting a single enemy.
achievements.summary: Earn five or more play bonuses while defeating a single enemy.

guide.context: Play bonuses are the post-fight commendations for things like no-damage finishes, fast defeats, heat actions and weapon or environment kills. They stack inside one fight, so a clean, aggressive fight against one durable enemy is the easiest setup.

steps.text: Start a street fight with a single enemy and avoid taking damage.
Use heat actions and finish the enemy quickly, ideally with a weapon or furniture.
Collect five bonus labels in that one fight; the achievement pops at the results screen.

achievements.description: Defeat Mr. Shakedown for the first time.
achievements.summary: Win your first fight against @enemy{Mr. Shakedown}.

guide.context: Mr. Shakedown wanders the streets and steals a large chunk of money when he wins, but the Chapter 2 story encounter is risk-free because losing it costs nothing. The Deep Pockets shrine skill increases the money won from him, and Zap Guns or Slime Guns pulled from ¥1,000,000 Dream Machines make later fights quick.

steps.text: During Chapter 2, fight @enemy{Mr. Shakedown} when he first appears on the street.
Knock him down with combos, weapons or a Zap Gun; the achievement pops on the first victory.

achievements.description: Get the best weapon search results report.
achievements.summary: Earn the 'Crazy Unbelievable Success!' report from the Dragon & Tiger weapon dispatch in Sotenbori.

guide.context: Dragon & Tiger Sotenbori sends agents to world regions for weapons and parts, and the resulting report grade is random. Adding extra money to the agent's fee raises the odds of a better report, and saving before claiming a finished search lets a bad report be rerolled.

steps.text: Progress as Majima until @loc{Dragon & Tiger Sotenbori} is open in Chapter 3.
Send an agent on any search and add extra funds to the fee.
Save before claiming the result, claim it, and reload until the report reads 'Crazy Unbelievable Success!'; the achievement pops on that report.

achievements.displayName: Eye of the Dragon and Tiger
achievements.description: Obtain all equipment parts.
achievements.summary: Obtain all 96 equipment parts from the Dragon & Tiger dispatch.

guide.context: Parts come from specific region and agent combinations; the 50-agent commissions award guaranteed parts, and new parts feed weapon and gear crafting. Weapons (100) and gear items (70) are separate Completion List counters, and the author's crafting spend ran to roughly ¥5.8 billion. Running cheap agents until the wanted region appears, saving before claiming, and reloading for a missing part is the intended loop.

steps.text: Send agents on dispatch cycles, prioritizing the 50-agent guaranteed-reward commissions.
Save before claiming results and reload until the report contains a missing part.
Collect all 96 equipment parts; the achievement pops on the final new part.

achievements.description: Defeat 30 or more opponents in Endless Rout.
achievements.summary: Defeat 30 or more opponents in a single Endless Rout run at the Coliseum.

guide.context: Endless Rout unlocks after reaching Rank B in the Standard Coliseum and fights as a survival tower against randomized opponents. A purchased ruleset can allow weapons and any fighting style, so strong upgrades, a Zap Gun and heat actions carry a 30-kill run.

steps.text: Raise the Standard Coliseum rank to B to unlock @mechanic{Endless Rout}.
Buy a ruleset such as Coliseum Style Standard and start an Endless Rout run.
Defeat opponents until the run counter passes 30; the achievement pops during the run.

achievements.description: Play every minigame.
achievements.summary: Play all 25 minigames at least once; starting and quitting a minigame counts.

guide.context: The 25 minigames span fighting, gambling, arcade and rhythm content across both cities. For this achievement, merely entering and quitting each game registers the play; the Completion List's 85 minigame counters ask for each game's full target instead.

collectibles.name: Disco
collectibles.location: @loc{Maharaja, Shichifuku Street (Kamurocho) or Maharaja, Shofukucho East (Sotenbori)}
collectibles.method: Start any song and finish or quit it; five songs at three difficulty tiers exist.

collectibles.name: Pocket Circuit
collectibles.location: @loc{Pocket Circuit Stadium, west end of Shichifuku Street}
collectibles.method: Enter the stadium and start any race.

collectibles.name: Karaoke
collectibles.location: @loc{Heroine Karaoke Bar, Pink Street (Kiryu); Utahime, Sotenbori (Majima)}
collectibles.method: Start any song and finish or quit it.

collectibles.name: Telephone Club
collectibles.method: Start a call session in Chapter 5 or later.

collectibles.name: Batting Center
collectibles.method: Buy a round and swing at any course.

collectibles.name: Darts
collectibles.method: Play one game at any setting.

collectibles.name: Pool
collectibles.method: Play one game of pool or puzzle pool.

collectibles.name: Bowling
collectibles.method: Bowl one game in any mode.

collectibles.name: Shogi
collectibles.method: Start one match against the computer.

collectibles.name: Catfight (JCC)
collectibles.location: @loc{Underground arena at Theater Square, opened by the Beyond the Door substory}
collectibles.method: Enter a tournament and bet on a fight.

collectibles.name: UFO Catcher
collectibles.method: Play the claw machine once.

collectibles.name: Out Run
collectibles.method: Start a run at the arcade cabinet.

collectibles.name: Super Hang-On
collectibles.location: @loc{SEGA HI-TECH LAND, Nakamichi Street, after Luka's friendship}
collectibles.method: Start a Beginner-course race.

collectibles.name: Space Harrier
collectibles.method: Start a run at the arcade cabinet.

collectibles.name: Fantasy Zone
collectibles.location: @loc{SEGA HI-TECH LAND, Sotenbori, after Kyoko's friendship}
collectibles.method: Start a run at the arcade cabinet.

collectibles.name: Fishing
collectibles.method: Cast a line once with any rod.

collectibles.name: Cee-lo
collectibles.method: Place one bet at the dice table.

collectibles.name: Cho-han
collectibles.method: Place one odd-or-even bet.

collectibles.name: Oicho-kabu
collectibles.method: Play one hand of the card game.

collectibles.name: Koi-koi
collectibles.method: Play one round of the Hanafuda game.

collectibles.name: Baccarat
collectibles.method: Buy chips and place one bet.

collectibles.name: Roulette
collectibles.method: Buy chips and place one number bet.

collectibles.name: Blackjack
collectibles.method: Play one hand at any table.

collectibles.name: Poker
collectibles.method: Play one hand of Texas Hold 'Em or Omaha.

collectibles.name: Mahjong
collectibles.location: @loc{Orchid Palace Mahjong, Nakamichi Alley; Jambalaya, Sotenbori}
collectibles.method: Start one quarter game.

achievements.description: Go on a date with a girl you met at the telephone club.
achievements.summary: Complete a date with a girl met at the Teltel Telephone Club.

guide.context: Only three telephone club girls lead to dates: Riku (blue bikini), Ayaka (white bikini) and Haruki (green bikini). Answers during the call and the post-date choice must be correct, and the other colours produce failed-date substories instead. Completing a date finishes that girl's substory and awards her video clip.

steps.text: Reach Chapter 5 and play the telephone club at @loc{Teltel Boys Club} in Kamurocho.
Win a call with Riku (blue), Ayaka (white) or Haruki (green) by answering her questions and matching the bikini colour.
At Theater Square, choose 'Talk to the Girl in Front' for Riku, 'Move in for a Better Look' then 'Talk to the Farther Woman' for Ayaka, or 'Talk to the Farther Woman' and win the fight for Haruki.
Finish the date to the end of the substory; the achievement pops at completion.

achievements.description: Complete every disco song on any difficulty.
achievements.summary: Complete all five disco songs at Maharaja on any difficulty.

guide.context: The songs are Friday Night, Queen of Passion, I'm Gonna Make Her Mine, I Wanna Take You Home and Koi no DISCO QUEEN. Either Maharaja location works and progress is shared, so the set can be split between Kiryu and Majima. Three-starring every song at every difficulty is only needed for the Completion List.

steps.text: Enter @loc{Maharaja} and pick a song.
Finish all five songs once each on any difficulty; the achievement pops after the fifth song.

achievements.description: Win ten bets on three-round tournaments at JCC.
achievements.summary: Win ten three-round tournaments at the JCC catfight arena.

guide.context: The JCC opens through the Beyond the Door substory in Chapter 6. A tournament runs three rounds, and betting the maximum of ¥99,990,000 banks wins and earnings quickly. Recorded winning picks: Francisca scissors, Jennifer rock, Maria scissors, Momoko scissors, Rei rock, Sayuri paper, Yuiko rock and Yurie scissors. Rainbow is the strongest fighter status and white the weakest, and some fights are unwinnable RNG losses.

steps.text: Open the JCC through the Beyond the Door substory and enter a three-round tournament.
Pick a fighter and bet the maximum on each round.
Win ten tournaments in total, saving between wins; the achievement pops on the tenth win.

achievements.description: Win all Pocket Circuit races.
achievements.summary: Win all seven Pocket Circuit races at the Pocket Circuit Stadium.

guide.context: The seven races run from the tutorial to the King of Speed Cup against Pocket Circuit Fighter's rivals. Parts and batteries come from Ebisu Pawn, Dream Machine pulls and race rewards, and several races are gated by friendship progress with Pocket Circuit Fighter. Late races depend on the car build and some luck, so adjusting the setup and restarting is normal.

collectibles.name: Introductory Race
collectibles.method: Win the tutorial race with the starter car.

collectibles.name: Little Racers' Cup
collectibles.method: Win with an early motor, tire and gear upgrade purchased from Ebisu Pawn.

collectibles.name: Rookies' Race
collectibles.method: Win against the rookie racers, using a balanced frame and better battery.

collectibles.name: Pro-Am Race
collectibles.method: Win with a faster motor and tuned tires; use boost on straights.

collectibles.name: Experts' Race
collectibles.method: Win with top-tier parts and careful cornering; retry if the car cannot hold the line.

collectibles.name: Champions' Cup
collectibles.method: Win against the champion racers with a full high-end build.

collectibles.name: King of Speed Cup
collectibles.method: Win the final cup; rebuild the car around the course and restart as needed, since the result is partly RNG.

achievements.description: Reach the end of the opening chapter in Kamurocho.
achievements.summary: Reach the end of the Chapter 1 prologue in Kamurocho in December 1988.

guide.context: The prologue covers Kiryu's errands for the Kazama Family and the infiltration of the Dojima family office. The achievement fires during the chapter's closing sequence once the story moves forward.

steps.text: Play the opening chapter's story missions, including the Dojima HQ infiltration and the boss fight.
Finish the chapter's closing cutscenes; the achievement pops at the chapter's end.

achievements.description: Complete Chapter 2.
achievements.summary: Complete Chapter 2 as Kiryu.

guide.context: Chapter 2 introduces Mr. Shakedown, the Beast style and the first missable drink request in Public Park 3. Its boss fight is easiest with Beast's furniture grabs.

steps.text: Play Chapter 2 through the apartment scenes, the Beast style tutorial and the city objectives.
Beat the chapter's boss; the achievement pops at the chapter's end.

achievements.description: Treat a homeless man to the expensive champagne.
achievements.summary: In Chapter 2, give the Public Park 3 homeless man the ¥20,000 Gold Champagne from Don Quijote.

guide.context: The homeless men in Public Park 3 each request a different drink, and only the champagne request awards this achievement. The cheaper requests use Malt Beer or Sweet Potato Shochu from Poppo Tenkaichi Street, Whiskey from Poppo Showa Street and Sake from M Store Shichifuku Street. Save before leaving the park so a wrong gift can be retried.

steps.text: In Chapter 2, reach @loc{Public Park 3} in Tenkaichi Alley and talk to the homeless men to learn which drinks they want.
Buy the @item{Gold Champagne} for ¥20,000 at @loc{Don Quijote Kamurocho}.
Give the Gold Champagne to the man who asked for champagne; the achievement pops immediately.

achievements.displayName: A Matter of Life or Death
achievements.description: Complete Chapter 4.
achievements.summary: Complete Chapter 4 as Majima.

guide.context: Chapter 4 includes the Teltel Telephone Club introduction, the Makoto escort and the first major boss fight. During the escort, move only when patrolling enemies look away and stay near Makoto so she is not grabbed.

steps.text: Play Chapter 4 through the telephone club and massage parlor scenes.
Escort Makoto through Sotenbori by advancing between blue blending zones while patrols face away.
Beat the chapter's boss; the achievement pops at the chapter's end.

achievements.description: Negotiate the best terms at the Odyssey club.
achievements.summary: In Chapter 3, talk to all three informants before the Odyssey and examine Mr. Libido plus all four tables inside; the achievement arrives in Chapter 4.

guide.context: Entering the Odyssey before all three informants are consulted locks the ideal-terms outcome for that attempt. The informants are Matsu the Barker on Bishamon Bridge, the College Hostess Hopeful at Bunzaemon Outdoor Mall and two men on Shofukucho South. Inside, Mr. Libido and four tables must each be examined: the left five-person table, the empty table slightly middle-left, the middle four-person table and the right four-person table. The unlock fires when Majima walks into the Grand as Chapter 4 begins.

steps.text: As Majima in Chapter 3, before entering the Odyssey, talk to @npc{Matsu the Barker} at Bishamon Bridge, the @npc{College Hostess Hopeful} at Bunzaemon Outdoor Mall and the two men on Shofukucho South.
Enter the @loc{Odyssey} and examine @npc{Mr. Libido} plus all four tables around the room.
Continue into Chapter 4 and enter the Grand; the achievement pops at the entrance.

achievements.description: Complete Chapter 6.
achievements.summary: Complete Chapter 6 as Kiryu.

guide.context: Chapter 6 opens the JCC, teaches the money-throw ability and ends with timed alley fights against waves of enemies; heat actions do not consume the timer, making them free damage under the time limits.

steps.text: Play through the Empty Lot and JCC setup scenes.
Clear the timed alley fights, using heat actions to beat enemies without losing seconds.
Beat the chapter's boss; the achievement pops at the chapter's end.

achievements.description: Impress Oda with perfect manners at Cafe Alps.
achievements.summary: At Cafe Alps in Chapter 5, pick 'Table near the back', 'Take the nearest seat' and 'Order nothing', then pass the business-card QTE.

guide.context: Save before entering the restaurant, because failing the QTE when Yamanoi arrives voids the attempt. The achievement fires as the conversation fades to black.

steps.text: Save at a payphone before entering @loc{Cafe Alps} with Oda in Chapter 5.
When prompted, choose 'Table near the back', then 'Take the nearest seat', then 'Order nothing'.
When Yamanoi arrives, pass the QTE to hand over the business card; the achievement pops as the scene ends.

achievements.description: Complete Chapter 8.
achievements.summary: Complete Chapter 8 as Majima.

guide.context: Chapter 8 opens with a boss fight at the Grand and closes with the second Makoto escort. Keeping Makoto close and using Breaker on groups keeps her from being grabbed; she regenerates health between fights.

steps.text: Win the opening Grand boss fight using Slugger combos.
During the warehouse escape, stay close to Makoto and clear the escort fights.
Finish the chapter; the achievement pops at the chapter's end.

achievements.description: Let the takoyaki go cold before delivering it.
achievements.summary: In Chapter 7, buy takoyaki from Magutako and wait more than 15 minutes in-game before returning to the warehouse.

guide.context: Majima is buying the takoyaki for Makoto, and the achievement only counts if the delivery takes longer than 15 minutes. The wait can be spent idling anywhere in the city; a save made before returning lets the story continue with fresh takoyaki after the achievement pops.

steps.text: In Chapter 7, when Majima is sent for takoyaki, buy it from @loc{Magutako} to the north.
Stay out in the city for more than 15 minutes without returning; idling works, and the achievement pops when the takoyaki turns cold.
Buy fresh takoyaki or reload the save made before returning to continue the story.

achievements.description: Complete Chapter 10.
achievements.summary: Complete Chapter 10 as Kiryu.

guide.context: Chapter 10 contains the Tojo HQ battle alongside Oda and Tachibana where the It Takes Two co-op finishers happen, and it ends with the reveal at Chen's. Save before meeting Oda at West Park.

steps.text: Play through the Oda and Tachibana battle at Tojo HQ.
After the chapter's fights and scenes, finish at Chen's; the achievement pops at the chapter's end.

achievements.description: Defeat three foes with Oda's or Tachibana's co-op moves.
achievements.summary: In Chapter 10, perform three heat actions on enemies held by Oda or Tachibana during the Tojo HQ battle.

guide.context: Oda and Tachibana periodically pin enemies, and a heat action beside the pinned enemy counts as a co-op finish. The battle is long enough to build heat with Rush or heat drinks, but the counter can lag, so reload the pre-West-Park save if three finishers do not register.

steps.text: Save at the payphone before meeting Oda at @loc{West Park}.
During the long Tojo HQ battle, watch for Oda or Tachibana grabbing an enemy and use a heat action next to that enemy.
Perform three co-op finishes; the achievement pops on the third. If it does not register, reload the save and repeat.

achievements.description: Complete Chapter 12.
achievements.summary: Complete Chapter 12 as Majima.

guide.context: Chapter 12's long battle ends with the two safes needed for They Won't Mind and a boss whose final health bar glows, making him nearly impossible to knock down; block after each combo and punish openings.

steps.text: Clear the multi-room battle, breaking the two safes before the stairs for @npc{They Won't Mind}.
Beat the boss through his glowing final phase using blocks and heat actions.
Finish the chapter; the achievement pops at the chapter's end.

achievements.description: Steal the hidden consortium funds.
achievements.summary: In Chapter 12, break the two safes in the back corner before the staircase for ¥100,000,000.

guide.context: The two safes sit on the floor near a vending machine in the back corner of the room before the stairs. Taking the stairs triggers a boss fight and cuts off access for the rest of the attempt.

steps.text: Save before entering the warehouse long battle in Chapter 12.
Fight to the room with the fan-wielding enemy and find the two safes in the back corner before the staircase.
Break both safes for ¥100,000,000; the achievement pops on the second break. If skipped, reload the save and retry.

achievements.description: Complete Chapter 14.
achievements.summary: Complete Chapter 14 as Kiryu.

guide.context: The chapter's fourth Kuze fight gives Kiryu allies against added goons; clearing the goons with Beast before focusing on Kuze keeps the fight manageable.

steps.text: Play through the Little Asia and West Park scenes.
During the boss fight, clear the goons with Beast, then defeat Kuze.
Finish the chapter; the achievement pops at the chapter's end.

achievements.description: Defeat the afro-wearing yakuza on the highway.
achievements.summary: In Chapter 13's highway chase, shoot the white-suited afro yakuza leaning from the car on the right side.

guide.context: The afro target appears a few seconds after the fourth motorcycle goes down and stays only briefly. Heat slow-motion gives a clean window for headshots; if the car escapes, reload the save made before the CAL Video sequence.

steps.text: Save at the payphone before entering @loc{CAL Video} in Chapter 13.
During the chase, defeat the first four motorcycles, then trigger heat slow-motion as the car with the afro yakuza pulls alongside on the right.
Kill the afro yakuza before his car leaves; the achievement pops on the kill. If missed, reload the save and retry.

achievements.description: Complete Chapter 16.
achievements.summary: Complete Chapter 16 as Majima.

guide.context: The Sebastian Building lobby and roof fights are the chapter's spikes; Breaker clears the crowds, and stocking healing items before the taxi prevents a long retry.

steps.text: Follow the chapter's scenes and clear the Empty Lot fight.
Ride a taxi to the @loc{Sebastian Building}, then clear the lobby and roof battles with Breaker.
Finish the chapter; the achievement pops at the chapter's end.

achievements.description: Take the full force of Reina's attack.
achievements.summary: In Chapter 15's Serena fight, fail the QTE when Majima is grabbed on the boss's final health bar so Reina hits him with a bottle.

guide.context: The bottle QTE appears once, when the boss's last health bar starts and he grabs Majima; doing nothing lets Reina land the hit. The next prompt is the healing-bottle interception and should be passed. Save before entering Serena.

steps.text: Save before entering @loc{Serena} in Chapter 15.
Fight the boss to his final health bar and let the grab QTE fail by pressing nothing; the achievement pops when Reina smashes the bottle.
Press the next prompt to intercept the healing bottle and finish the fight.

achievements.description: Complete the final chapter.
achievements.summary: Complete the Final Chapter (Chapter 17) and its closing boss fight.

guide.context: The finale alternates between Kiryu and Majima across several boss fights with point-of-no-return swaps, so both characters need healing items stocked. The final encounter has five health bars and two QTE sequences, with the closing stretch alternating mashing and dodge prompts.

steps.text: Clear the Kiryu and Majima finale sections, healing between fights and grabbing the items on the ground.
Beat the final boss: dodge in Rush, use furniture with Beast, then break his guard with Brawler as he blocks.
Complete the closing QTE sequence and watch the ending; the achievement pops when the story ends.

achievements.description: Complete the Real Estate Royale storyline.
achievements.summary: Complete Real Estate Royale by defeating the five area kings and the Finance King.

guide.context: Each king battle is a minigame challenge tied to that area's takeover, and losing one returns properties and market share, so save first. The Gambling King's challenge is RNG-heavy and commonly save-scummed. Completion awards the Dragon of Dojima style.

steps.text: Take over each Kamurocho area by reaching 100% share and beating its king: Leisure, Electronics, Pleasure, Gambling, then Media.
With all five areas controlled, accept the Finance King's challenge and win.
Watch the storyline's closing scenes; the achievement pops with the Dragon of Dojima unlock.

achievements.description: Complete the Cabaret Club Czar storyline.
achievements.summary: Complete Cabaret Club Czar by defeating all five rival clubs and Kotomi's lackeys.

guide.context: Rival battles open at 1,500 fans (Mars), 3,000 (Jupiter), 4,000 (Mercury), 5,000 (Venus) and 10,000 (Moon). Losing costs only some fans and can be retried, and each win adds a platinum hostess. Defeating Club Moon and then Kotomi's four lackeys at the Grand unlocks the Mad Dog of Shimano style.

steps.text: Run Club Sunshine nights to grow fans to the next area's threshold.
Defeat the rival clubs in order: Hino (Mars), Kizuka (Jupiter), Mizumura (Mercury), Kanehara (Venus) and Tsukiyama (Moon).
After Club Moon falls, beat Kotomi's four lackeys at the Grand; the achievement pops with the Mad Dog of Shimano unlock.

achievements.description: Get a cigarette lit as the undisputed king of an area.
achievements.summary: After taking over any Real Estate area, stand in front of the smoker on Tenkaichi Street near Serena in the evening until he lights a cigarette.

guide.context: The cigarette event only appears once an area's share reaches 100%. The man on Tenkaichi Street near Serena triggers it reliably and appears in the evening. Staying in place is the mechanic: idle for roughly 15 seconds, continuing to idle even after the dialogue box appears.

steps.text: Dominate one Real Estate area so its share reads 100%.
In the evening, find the smoking man on @loc{Tenkaichi Street} near @loc{Serena} and stand in front of him.
Idle in place for about 15 seconds without walking away; the achievement pops when he offers the light.

achievements.description: Clear every Climax Battle challenge.
achievements.summary: Clear all 32 Climax Battles across the Proving Grounds, Melee, Millionaire and Ultimate sections.

guide.context: Climax Battles unlock after the main story and use fixed loadouts: Weak stages have no abilities, Strong stages have all three styles' abilities and health upgrades, and some stages lock a single style. Heat actions stop challenge timers, so spending heat is always safe, and Beast and Breaker carry most stages.

collectibles.name: Proving Grounds 1 — Weak Kiryu, Brawler
collectibles.method: Use the cannon and weapon heat actions; armed enemies ignore unarmed strikes.

collectibles.name: Proving Grounds 2 — Weak Kiryu, Beast
collectibles.method: Smash furniture and use heat actions against the group.

collectibles.name: Proving Grounds 3 — Weak Majima, Thug
collectibles.method: Win a straightforward fight where grabbing is unavailable.

collectibles.name: Proving Grounds 4 — Weak Majima, Slugger
collectibles.method: Win with slugger moves; weapon pickups are disabled.

collectibles.name: Proving Grounds 5 — Weak Kiryu, Rush
collectibles.method: Build heat on zombies and focus the four boss zombies while they are down.

collectibles.name: Proving Grounds 6 — Weak Majima, Breaker
collectibles.method: Reach ¥30,000,000 in two minutes against the Areshi brothers; avoid knockdowns to keep the multiplier.

collectibles.name: Proving Grounds 7 — Strong Kiryu, Beast
collectibles.method: Reach ¥30,000,000 in two minutes by breaking the red boxes and handling the gunmen.

collectibles.name: Proving Grounds 8 — Strong Majima, all styles
collectibles.method: Survive the dark and draining stage: build to the third heat bar, keep a Marlin Cannon for heat, and block.

collectibles.name: Proving Grounds 9 — Strong Kiryu, Legend
collectibles.method: Clear four waves without taking damage using grabs, throws and the bicycle heat action.

collectibles.name: Proving Grounds 10 — Strong Majima, Legend
collectibles.method: Defeat the shotgun user and guards, then the Nikkyo fan thrower; use the Savage/Chomp attack.

collectibles.name: Melee Battle 1 — Strong Kiryu, Brawler
collectibles.method: Clear three waves in 90 seconds; heat actions on the big fighters and the katana user.

collectibles.name: Melee Battle 2 — Strong Majima, Thug
collectibles.method: Clear three waves in 90 seconds; use heat actions but save some for high-HP enemies.

collectibles.name: Melee Battle 3 — Strong Kiryu, Rush
collectibles.method: Clear three waves in 90 seconds: random enemies, a boss, then Wang Baoli and Fist of God.

collectibles.name: Melee Battle 4 — Strong Majima, Slugger
collectibles.method: Clear three waves in 90 seconds using the Nunchaku combo and heat actions on blockers.

collectibles.name: Melee Battle 5 — Strong Kiryu, Beast
collectibles.method: Clear three waves in 60 seconds: pistols, then a shotgun, then unarmed enemies; use furniture.

collectibles.name: Melee Battle 6 — Strong Majima, Breaker
collectibles.method: Clear three waves in 90 seconds, punishing katana users with heat actions.

collectibles.name: Melee Battle 7 — Weak Kiryu, three styles
collectibles.method: Clear the single wave in 10 seconds; grab the shotgun ahead and use Rush with dodges.

collectibles.name: Melee Battle 8 — Weak Majima, three styles
collectibles.method: Clear the single wave in 10 seconds; grab the cannon on the right by the barrels.

collectibles.name: Melee Battle 9 — Strong Kiryu, three styles
collectibles.method: Clear the single wave in 150 seconds; build heat and use any style.

collectibles.name: Melee Battle 10 — Strong Majima, three styles
collectibles.method: Clear the single wave in 150 seconds with any fighting style.

collectibles.name: Millionaire Battle 1 — Weak Kiryu, three styles
collectibles.method: Defeat Mr. Shakedown in the open area using objects and Beast when he enrages.

collectibles.name: Millionaire Battle 2 — Weak Majima, three styles
collectibles.method: Defeat Mr. Shakedown in the tight area; bait his spin and use objects with Thug combos.

collectibles.name: Millionaire Battle 3 — Weak Kiryu, three styles
collectibles.method: Reach ¥10,000,000 in 90 seconds; avoid knockdowns and hits.

collectibles.name: Millionaire Battle 4 — Strong Majima, three styles
collectibles.method: Reach ¥30,000,000 without being hit; a Thug light-plus-heavy hit pays about ¥6,000,000.

collectibles.name: Millionaire Battle 5 — Strong Kiryu, three styles
collectibles.method: Defeat two Mr. Shakedowns in the Coliseum; build heat in Rush and spend it on heat actions.

collectibles.name: Millionaire Battle 6 — Strong Majima, three styles
collectibles.method: Defeat the two Mr. Shakedowns using Secret of the Strut or the Breaker dodge heat action.

collectibles.name: Ultimate Battle 1 — Strong Kiryu, three styles
collectibles.method: Beat Okabe and friends, Jun Oda and Daisaku Kuze with Beast throws and heat actions.

collectibles.name: Ultimate Battle 2 — Strong Majima, three styles
collectibles.method: Beat Wen Hai Lee, Homare Nishitani and Masaru Sera; dodge Sera's attacks and punish with heat actions.

collectibles.name: Ultimate Battle 3 — Strong Kiryu, three styles

achievements.description: Defeat So and Jo Amon.
achievements.summary: Defeat So Amon as Kiryu and Jo Amon as Majima in the final two substories.

guide.context: Substories 99 and 100 only appear after every other substory for that character is complete, and both fights take place at the Bullfighting Arena in the final chapter. So Amon uses a cannon and lasers as Kiryu's opponent, while Jo Amon has many health bars as Majima's; bringing Habu drinks and strong weapons keeps the fights short.

steps.text: Complete every substory except the two Amon fights.
As Kiryu, start substory 99 at the @loc{Bullfighting Arena} and defeat @enemy{So Amon}.
As Majima, start substory 100 at the Bullfighting Arena and defeat @enemy{Jo Amon}; the achievement pops after both wins.
